steps.sent: "what does kabsi do for my restaurant"

replies.body:
For a restaurant, Kabsi takes care of three things that eat up time: it drafts a reply for every new Google review in the customer's own language, it watches your listing so your hours, phone and menu details stay right (and flags it if Google or someone else changes them), and it prepares weekly posts you can approve, like a seasonal dish or an event. You always approve before anything goes live, nothing gets posted on its own.

It also gives you a free review link and QR code you can put on tables or receipts, so every guest gets the same easy way to leave a review.

What's your name, and is it a sit-down restaurant, takeaway, or something else?

steps.sent: "what happens to my reviews if I cancel"

replies.body:
If you cancel a plan, your reviews on Google stay exactly where they are, nothing happens to them. What stops is Kabsi's side: new drafts, Google Protection, and the Weekly Care Report. Your review link and QR code keep working even after you cancel.

A monthly plan can be cancelled any time, and yearly plans are refundable in full within 14 days of starting. Want me to tell you more about how Kabsi works day to day?

The review link and QR code are free for everyone, no plan needed. Beyond that, Kabsi has Essentials at $19 a month ($190 a year) and Pro at $39 a month ($390 a year), with a 14-day free Pro trial and no card needed to start. Card payments aren't open yet though, so there's nothing to actually pay today.

What kind of business do you run? I can point out which parts would help you most.
